topic.label: Claude Tag
topic.desc: Claude Tag, Claude in Slack: how it works, agent identity, connectors, routines, admin setup and use.

skills: Claude Tag puts Claude in your Slack channels with admin-governed access. See what to hand it, how setup works, and where to start as an admin or end user. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/overview

Each Claude Tag thread in Slack runs a working session in a sandbox. See how progress shows in the thread, how to steer mid-task, what survives between turns, and how memory is scoped. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/concepts/how-it-works

Claude Tag terms defined in one place, including agent identity, bundle, connector, personal connector, scope, Agent Proxy, routine, and session. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/concepts/glossary

Claude Tag acts under its own service accounts in Slack channels, not as you. See how channel access is bounded, how credentials reach it, how Claude uses your personal connectors for your own tasks in a channel, and why DMs differ. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/concepts/agent-identity

Claude can use your own claude.ai connectors, called personal connectors, for your tasks in a Slack channel. See how you approve connector use, when Claude asks you to review a result before posting it, and what other people in the channel can reach. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/concepts/personal-connectors

How Claude Tag keeps credentials out of the sandbox, limits where a channel session's requests can go, and controls who can see artifacts and invoke Claude. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/concepts/security-and-data

What Claude Tag stores on Anthropic's side, how long session transcripts and memory are kept, and what disconnecting a workspace, uninstalling the app, deleting a Slack channel, removing a scope, or leaving the organization does to that data. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/concepts/data-lifecycle

Claude Tag settings map: the admin page for access and behavior, the usage page for spend limits, the in-Slack Configure link for channel instructions, and personal connectors for DMs and your own tasks in channels. Claude Managed Agents is configured separately on the Claude Platform. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/concepts/settings-map
Claude Tag for Claude Code users

Which parts of a Claude Code setup carry into Claude Tag, which move to admin settings, and how Slack threads map to sessions. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/concepts/for-claude-code-users
What the Claude Slack app can access

What the Claude app reads and posts in Slack, the OAuth scopes it requests, and what installing it does not grant. Written for the Slack admin approving the install. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/for-slack-admins

Set up Claude Tag for your organization: pair your Slack workspace, add Claude to channels, launch, give Claude access to your tools, and check that it works. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/setup-overview
Give Claude access to your tools

Add connectors so Claude Tag acts in your tools with its own credentials. Covers service accounts, bundles, allowed websites, domain entries, and plugins. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/add-connections

Give Claude its own GitHub identity through the Claude GitHub App. Covers linking your GitHub organization, granting repositories, and GitHub Actions. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/configure-github

Give Claude its own GitLab identity to read projects, manage issues, review merge requests, and check pipelines. Covers the account, token, and connector. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/configure-gitlab
Claude Tag channel work bills to your organization's usage balance. Set the spend limit and see what happens when it's reached. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/set-spend-limit
Set up Claude Tag for on-call

Put Claude on call for incident response in Slack: run setup at claude.ai/oncall, pick or auto-join incident channels, cap spend, and deploy. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/setup-oncall

Step-by-step setup for each tool Claude Tag can connect to. Each guide covers the dedicated account to create, the credential to enter, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/overview
Connect a service that isn't in the list

Connect a tool that isn't in Claude Tag's connector list. Covers credential types, what each form field means, and how to add a custom MCP server. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/custom

Connect Amplitude to Claude Tag with a project API key and secret key, or by signing in with Amplitude, so Claude can answer product-analytics questions. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/amplitude

Connect Asana to Claude Tag so it can file tasks and read project status. Covers the dedicated account to create, the token fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/asana
Connect Atlassian Cloud to Claude Tag so it can read and update Jira issues and search Confluence pages. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/atlassian
Connect BigQuery to Claude Tag so it can run read-only queries on your datasets, using a GCP service-account key. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/bigquery

Connect Datadog to Claude Tag so it can query metrics, logs, and monitors. Covers the dedicated account to create, the API key fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/datadog

Connect GitLab to Claude Tag so it can read code, manage issues, comment on merge requests, and check pipelines through the GitLab API. Covers token permissions, self-managed hostnames, and how it differs from GitHub. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/gitlab

Connect Gong to Claude Tag so it can pull call summaries and deal context. Covers the dedicated account to create, the token fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/gong
Connect Google Drive, Calendar, and Gmail

Connect Google Drive, Calendar, and Gmail to Claude Tag so it can read docs, sheets, events, and email. Covers OAuth setup, the service-account option, and what each grants. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/google

Connect HubSpot to Claude Tag so it can read pipeline, deal, and contact data. Covers the dedicated account to create, the token fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/hubspot

Connect Linear to Claude Tag so it can file tickets and post status updates. Covers the dedicated account to create, the token fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/linear

Connect Notion to Claude Tag so it can read and search your Notion workspace. Covers the dedicated account to create, the token fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/notion

Connect PagerDuty to Claude Tag so it can read incidents and on-call schedules. Covers the dedicated account to create, the token fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/pagerduty

Connect Salesforce to Claude Tag so it can read and update CRM records. Covers the connected app to create, the client credential fields, and the host to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/salesforce

Connect Sentry to Claude Tag so it can pull errors and stack traces into threads. Covers the dedicated account to create, the token fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/sentry

Connect Snowflake to Claude Tag so it can run read-only queries on your warehouse. Covers the dedicated user to create, the access token field, and the host to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/snowflake

Connect Stripe to Claude Tag so it can answer billing and subscription questions. Covers the dedicated account to create, the key fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/stripe

Connect Vercel to Claude Tag so it can check deployment status and logs. Covers the dedicated account to create, the token fields, and the URL to allow. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/connections/vercel

Claude Tag proves its identity to your systems with a short-lived signed token instead of a credential stored in Claude. Learn how the token works and which of the four connection types to use. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/federated-access/overview

Connect a gateway you run so Claude Tag can call your internal services with a short-lived identity token instead of a stored credential. Covers what the gateway must check, how to register it in the console, and how to verify the connection. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/federated-access/connect-a-gateway

Let Claude sign in to an IAM role in your AWS account with a short-lived identity token instead of stored access keys. Covers the identity provider and trust policy to create in AWS, how to connect the role in the console, and how to verify the connection in CloudTrail. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/federated-access/aws

Let Claude call Google Cloud through workload identity federation with a short-lived identity token instead of a service account key. Covers the pool, provider, and IAM grants to create, with or without a service account, and how to connect the identity in the console. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/federated-access/gcp

Let Claude exchange a short-lived identity token for an access token from an OAuth 2.0 authorization server you run, then call your APIs with it. Covers what your token endpoint receives and must check, what it returns, and how to register it in the console. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/federated-access/authorization-server

The claims, issuer, signing keys, lifetime, and subject format of the identity token Claude Tag presents to a gateway, cloud provider, or authorization server. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/federated-access/token-reference

Counts, lengths, lifetimes, and unsupported configurations for Claude Tag's federated agent access: gateways, AWS roles, Google Cloud identities, and authorization servers. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/federated-access/limits

Errors from Claude Tag's federated agent access and what fixes each: console dialog messages, requests Claude reports as blocked or failed, and rejections your gateway, AWS, Google Cloud, or authorization server records. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/federated-access/troubleshooting

Choose which Slack workspaces and channels a Claude Tag bundle applies to, attach bundles to channels by name, and see how access stacks when bundles overlap. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/attach-to-scope

Claude Tag responds only where it has been added and addressed. See who can invoke it, what changes in guest and Slack Connect channels, the per-scope version setting, how to limit it to chosen channels, how to delegate administration or a channel's setup, and how to quiet or remove it. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/restrict-access

Connect more Slack workspaces or an Enterprise Grid to Claude Tag, choose which Claude Tag version each channel uses, and disconnect a workspace. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/workspaces
Use Claude Tag at a healthcare organization

Claude Tag is not covered by Anthropic's Business Associate Agreement. Configure it so protected health information never reaches a channel, direct message, or tool Claude can read: limit Claude to approved channels, turn off direct messages, and connect only PHI-free tools. Also covers what to do i… Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/healthcare

Claude Tag is customized per channel and workspace (a scope), not per user. See what admins set in claude.ai, what anyone can change from the channel, and what stays fixed. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/customize
Manage a channel's instructions from another channel

Managed by lets a central team write a Slack channel's standing Claude instructions from its own channel. Covers setup, the Confirm card, and limits. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/managed-by
Set up a skills repository Claude can update

Put your org's Claude Tag skills in a git repository with auto-sync, grant Claude write access, and Claude can open pull requests to improve its own skills from what it learns in channels. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/skills-repo
Review what Claude Tag has done

Claude Tag actions appear under its own service accounts in each connected tool's audit log. See what the Activity page covers, how to trace an action to its source, and where each connected tool keeps logs. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/audit

Pull channel spend per Slack user from the Claude Enterprise Analytics API for showback or chargeback reporting, and see how Claude's work is attributed to people. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/attribute-costs

Error messages from Claude Tag setup and what fixes each. Covers permission mismatches, GitHub access gaps, session start failures, and account errors. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/troubleshooting

Claude Tag reaches your services from a published egress range, over HTTP and HTTPS only. See the IP block to allowlist and how the allowlist relates to the allowed-websites setting on a connection. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/network-requirements
Migrate from the earlier Claude in Slack

Claude Tag replaces the earlier per-user Claude in Slack app in place. See what changes, what stays, how the version is chosen per channel, and what existing users notice. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/admins/migrate-from-earlier

Claude Tag works in your Slack channels. See how to check it's on, send your first message, what it can read, and why DMs work differently. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/getting-started

A few exact, bang-prefixed words after an @-mention run a fixed action instead of starting a normal turn: see the command list, get the link to a channel's settings page, restart a stuck or wrong-context session, check whether Claude is still working in a thread or channel, mute or unmute a thread,… Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/commands

What Claude Tag does with a channel message nobody tagged it in, and how to turn unprompted replies off for a thread or a channel. Read this if Claude is replying too much, or went quiet. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/when-claude-responds
Use Claude Tag in a group DM

Add Claude to a Slack group DM to share a task with a few people. See whose access and billing apply, when Claude replies, and what differs from a channel. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/group-dms
Good habits for working with Claude Tag

Name the outcome, give every task a definition of done, and pick the right channel. See how to write tasks Claude can finish and how to keep many threads reviewable. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/good-habits

Claude Tag runs routines you set up from a channel. See scheduled jobs, channel watching, pull request subscriptions, where results post, and how to pause them. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/proactivity

Claude Tag memory belongs to the channel, not to you. See what each channel keeps, which notes are shared across the workspace, and how to check or correct them. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/memory
Choose the model Claude Tag uses

Ask Claude to switch models in a Slack thread, set a channel's default model, pick the model for your direct messages, or run a thread in fast mode. See which models you can use and how to confirm which one replied. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/models

Copy-paste prompts for Claude Tag in Slack, each with why it works. See first messages, handoffs, channel rules, memory checks, routines, fan-out, and steering. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/prompt-library
Troubleshoot Claude Tag in channels and DMs

Fixes for common Claude Tag problems in Slack. See no reply after a reaction, queued or failed sessions, lost work, missing connections, blocked links and websites, and DM or account errors. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/troubleshooting

Shapes of work teams hand Claude Tag in Slack, each with prompts to paste. See triage, catch-up, docs and tickets, project tracking, data, deals, monitoring, and bug fixes. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases

Claude Tag triages a Slack request channel with two setup messages. See in-thread answers, duplicate flags, owner routing, weekly theme rollups, optional ticket filing, and runbooks of standing answers. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/triage-requests

Claude Tag summarizes Slack threads and channels on demand. See one-off recaps, a scheduled morning rollup of open threads, and what's waiting on you. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/catch-up

Create a Slack channel for you and Claude Tag alone and run your work from it. See scratch questions, digests of channels you don't follow, a weekly status digest, follow-ups chased until they close, and a handoff that covers your time away. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/your-own-channel
Turn threads into docs and tickets

Claude Tag turns a Slack discussion into the artifact you name. See replies you can send, decision docs, status memos, filed tickets, hosted web pages, page comments that reach Claude, and a capture-channel pattern. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/create-artifacts

Claude Tag posts project digests no one has to compile. See standing status updates and follow-ups on contracts, design reviews, and pull requests until they close. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/track-projects

Claude Tag answers data questions in the Slack thread. See warehouse queries with charts, scheduled metric reports, and charts built from channel history alone. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/answer-data-questions

Claude Tag finds answers in connected docs and replies in the thread. See policy lookups, runbook checks, prior decisions, and answers from the Slack channel alone. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/find-answers

Claude Tag reviews documents in a connected tool against a checklist or policy and posts findings in the thread. See single-document checks, batch reviews, filing lists, comparisons with past reviews, and a scheduled weekly sweep. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/review-documents

Claude Tag pulls account and deal state into the Slack channel. See in-thread account answers, pre-call briefs, and a scheduled weekly pipeline digest. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/pull-deal-state

Claude Tag recipes for marketing teams in Slack. See policy answers in an intake channel, campaign channel recaps and send-ready drafts, lead and campaign state from the CRM, a weekly metrics digest, and brand voice rules saved to channel memory. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/marketing-team

Claude Tag watches dashboards and alert channels so you see one line per issue. See scheduled checks, alert investigation before anyone asks, and the prompts to set both up. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/watch-monitors

Claude Tag takes a bug report from Slack to a draft pull request. See reproducing the issue, watching a bug channel, root-cause digs, and following CI to green. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/fix-bugs

Claude Tag works with your GitHub repositories from Slack: answer questions in-thread, subscribe to pull requests, and hand back chores as draft pull requests. Source: https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/users/use-cases/work-with-github
mcp: Anthropic's official MCP server for searching and reading the Claude Developer Platform documentation (Streamable HTTP at https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp).
